rows.text: You advance smoothly through every round of Castrum Kremnos' tournament. Alas, the King's Aegis' intervention stops your progress. But a hero must not give up. Kephale above, you carry the shield given to you by your comrade, pressing forth on your journey across Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In Janusopolis' temple, you seek a prophecy from its priests: Where should one go, if one wanted to be a hero?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Hunt the boar that has been twisted by the black tide.
You all lure the howling behemoth into the trap, but it breaks free of its fetters in its dying moments, launching a final, desperate lunge at the group.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Word has it that a perilous expedition with one's life on the line is about to begin. You board a ship, anticipating adventurous stories of the uncharted.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Slay the monster in the valley.
That is a monster that feeds on both humans and livestock. As it slumbers, you lunge forward and pierce it in its eye.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
